claims: Cowork is 'officially dead': Anthropic merged Claude Chat and Cowork; the only modes now are Claude or Code
New output dropdown lets you pick the file type Claude makes and set up a design system
Creator: Stanford founder, AI startup raised $4M; runs a scheduled 8am daily industry-news briefing
how_to_steps: Step 1: create a folder on your laptop called 'Claude' as the shared workspace
Step 2: inside it create 'About Me' with files on your background, business, writing samples, past projects
Step 3: create a new Project in Claude, write project instructions, connect the Claude folder as context
Step 4: Settings -> Connectors, connect Gmail, Calendar, Notion etc. so Claude can send emails/draft docs
Step 5: inside the project create scheduled tasks (e.g. 8am daily briefing)
